name: Resy
description: Resy restaurant discovery and reservation availability from Resy's own web API: city lookup, venue search with inline slots, venue details, per-day availability with booked-out vs closed distinction, availability calendars and slot deposit/cancellation conditions. Read-only: no bookings, holds or notifications.

tools.name: Availability
tools.description: Given a venue_id (from search_venues or venue) and a date. One upstream availability call plus one calendar call.

options.name: day
options.about: Calendar day: YYYY-MM-DD, `today`, `tomorrow` or `+N` days from today. Relative days resolve on the UTC calendar. Pattern: ^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}|today|tomorrow|\+[0-9]{1,3})$.

options.name: party_size
options.about: Number of guests (default 2).

options.name: time_filter
options.about: Preferred time HH:MM (24h, venue-local); the site returns slots around it. Pattern: ^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$.

options.name: venue_id
options.about: Resy venue id (`id.resy`, e.g. 77859).

response.about: Bookable reservation slots of one venue for a day and party size (venue-local times, seating type, payment/cancellation terms, slot tokens), with the venue's calendar state for that day so an empty result says whether the venue is closed on Resy, booked out or beyond its booking horizon.

fields.name: config_token
fields.about: Slot token `rgs://resy/...`; input to `slot_conditions`.

fields.name: exclusive
fields.about: True when the slot is card-member exclusive inventory.

fields.name: quantity
fields.about: Tables the site reports for this slot; null when not disclosed.

fields.name: seating_type
fields.about: Site's seating label (`Counter`, `Table`, `Dining Room`, ...).

fields.name: service_type_id
fields.about: 1 breakfast, 2 dinner, 3 lunch, 4 brunch as used by the site.

fields.name: start
fields.about: Venue-local wall clock `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (no offset; see `time_zone`).

templates.about:
At Sushi Aozora, we honor the timeless traditions of Japanese omakase while embracing a spirit of modern refinement. Nestled in the heart of Union Square, our intimate counter offers a serene setting where guests can experience the artistry of sushi and kappo dining up close.

Our tasting menu is thoughtfully curated by a Michelin-awarded chef, blending classical techniques with contemporary sensibilities. Each course highlights the finest seasonal ingredients from Japan and beyond - from delicate, hand-formed nigiri to intricately composed small plates.

Guided by balance, seasonality, and elegance, every experience at Sushi Aozora reflects a deep respect for Japanese tradition while inviting guests to discover sushi through a lens of creativity, precision, and harmony.
templates.need_to_know:
Our Omakase, tasting menu is priced at $165 per person for 17 courses .

Seating times: 5:00 PM to 9:00 PM

Parties of 1 to 2 are provided with a 2 hour dining time.

Please plan to arrive promptly-within 10 to 15 minutes of your scheduled seating-to ensure you are able to enjoy the full 17-course experience. Late arrivals may result in missed courses, as our chef prepares ingredients daily based on the number of reservations in order to maintain the freshness and quality of the dishes served.

Running Late?
Please contact us by text at (347) 622-6776 if you anticipate being late. We will make every effort to accommodate you; however, we cannot guarantee the full omakase experience in the event of a delayed arrival.

Any arrival more than 30 minutes late without prior notification may result in the cancellation of your reservation.

Please make sure you can make your reservation date and time before finalizing your booking. We have a strict cancellation policy and do not provide refunds or credits for last minute cancellations. 

Our counter is intentionally intimate, and we kindly ask for punctuality and respect for the flow of service. 

Dietary Restrictions
If you or your guests have any food allergies or dietary restrictions, please kindly inform us when making your reservation. 
Can be accommodated: Shellfish, gluten free and kosher style restrictions. 
Cannot be accommodated: Gluten free, vegan and vegetarian diets.

tools.name: Calendar
tools.description: To find which days a venue has any table for a party size before calling availability, or to tell a closed day from a sold-out one.

options.name: days
options.about: Range length from start_date when end_date is omitted (default 30).

options.name: end_date
options.about: Calendar day: YYYY-MM-DD, `today`, `tomorrow` or `+N` days from today. Relative days resolve on the UTC calendar. Pattern: ^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}|today|tomorrow|\+[0-9]{1,3})$.

options.name: party_size
options.about: Number of guests (default 2).

options.name: start_date
options.about: Calendar day: YYYY-MM-DD, `today`, `tomorrow` or `+N` days from today. Relative days resolve on the UTC calendar. Pattern: ^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}|today|tomorrow|\+[0-9]{1,3})$.

options.name: venue_id
options.about: Resy venue id (`id.resy`, e.g. 77859).

response.about: Day-by-day reservation, event and walk-in inventory state of one venue for a party size over a date range (`available`, `not available`, `closed`), plus the last day the venue currently releases inventory for.

fields.name: reservation
fields.about: `available`, `not available` or `closed` as the site states.

tools.name: Locations
tools.description: First hop when you know a city name but not its Resy slug or coordinates. Returns the coordinates to pass to search_venues.

options.name: country_code
options.about: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 filter (e.g. `US`). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z]{2}$.

options.name: latitude
options.about: latitude

options.name: limit
options.about: Rows to return (default 50).

options.name: longitude
options.about: With latitude: order by distance and report `distance_km`.

options.name: query
options.about: Case-insensitive substring of the city name, code or slug (e.g. `new york`, `ny`).

response.about: List Resy cities (location code, slug, coordinates, time zone) filtered by name, country or proximity to coordinates. Codes and slugs are the identifiers other functions take.

fields.name: code
fields.about: Location code (`ny`); accepted by the site's collection and book-tonight routes.

fields.name: distance_km
fields.about: Great-circle distance from the input coordinates; null without them.

fields.name: radius
fields.about: City radius as the site states it (the web client multiplies it by 1610, i.e. miles).

fields.name: time_zone
fields.about: Site's zone name (IANA or POSIX-style such as `EST5EDT`).

fields.name: url_slug
fields.about: City slug (`new-york-ny`); the `location` input of `venue`.

tools.name: Search venues
tools.description: Discovery: find restaurants near a point (optionally by name or cuisine keyword) that have a table on a day. Follow with venue, availability or slot_conditions using venue_id and config_token.

options.name: day
options.about: Calendar day: YYYY-MM-DD, `today`, `tomorrow` or `+N` days from today. Relative days resolve on the UTC calendar. Pattern: ^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}|today|tomorrow|\+[0-9]{1,3})$.

options.name: include_tock_inventory
options.about: Also return Tock-hosted venues the site merges into search (default false).

options.name: latitude
options.about: latitude

options.name: longitude
options.about: longitude

options.name: page
options.about: 1-based page; pass `next_page` from the previous result.

options.name: party_size
options.about: Number of guests (default 2).

options.name: per_page
options.about: Hits per page (default 20).

options.name: query
options.about: Free text (name, cuisine); empty or omitted browses every venue in the radius.

options.name: radius_m
options.about: Search radius as the site takes it (default 16100, the web client's 10 miles).

options.name: time_filter
options.about: Preferred time HH:MM (24h, venue-local); the site returns slots around it. Pattern: ^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$.

response.about: Search Resy venues around coordinates by text, with each venue's bookable slots for a day and party size inline. One page per call.

fields.name: currency_code
fields.about: ISO 4217 code the venue prices in.

fields.name: is_tock_inventory
fields.about: True when the row is Tock-hosted inventory merged into Resy search.

fields.name: price_range_id
fields.about: Site's price band 1-4 ($ to $$$$).

fields.name: url
fields.about: Public venue page `https://resy.com/cities/{location}/venues/{slug}`.

venues.name: Sushi Yukimi
venues.why_we_like_it: It’s an intimate omakase spot, so named for the Japanese concept of “viewing snow,” or appreciating fleeting beauty. That’s exactly what we suggest you do when you dine here.

venues.name: Edoya Sushi
venues.why_we_like_it: This spot is a family affair, with chef Edgar working in the kitchen alongside his son. Together, they have a combined 30-plus years of experience, so you’re in good hands. They serve omakase, à la carte, lunch, and even breakfast. Only in New York could you order a BEC on a roll at the same place where you can have 13 courses of seasonal nigiri.

tools.name: Slot conditions
tools.description: After availability or search_venues returned a slot `config_token`. Alternatively give venue_id + day (+ optional start time and seating type) and the first matching slot of that day is described.

options.name: day
options.about: Calendar day: YYYY-MM-DD, `today`, `tomorrow` or `+N` days from today. Relative days resolve on the UTC calendar. Pattern: ^([0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}|today|tomorrow|\+[0-9]{1,3})$.

options.name: party_size
options.about: Number of guests (default 2).

options.name: seating_type
options.about: With venue_id: pick a slot with this seating label (e.g. `Counter`).

options.name: start_time
options.about: With venue_id: pick the slot starting at this venue-local time (default: first slot of the day). Pattern: ^([01][0-9]|2[0-3]):[0-5][0-9]$.

options.name: venue_id
options.about: Resy venue id (`id.resy`, e.g. 77859).

response.about: Deposit, prepayment and cancellation conditions of one reservation slot as the site discloses them before booking: policy text, fee amount and cut-off, charge breakdown (reservation charge, Resy fee, service fee, tax, total), currency and time zone. Read-only: no hold or booking is made.

fields.name: amounts
fields.about: Amounts in `currency` for the whole party as the site displays them before booking; tax is the site's figure (0 when none is charged) and `tax_included` says whether venue prices include tax.

fields.name: payment_type
fields.about: Site's payment configuration (`free`, `deposit`, `prepay`, ...).

fields.name: requires_payment
fields.about: False when `payment_type` is `free` and the total is 0.

fields.name: start
fields.about: Venue-local start `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` from the token.

policy:
A cancellation fee will not be charged if you cancel before Mon, Sep. 28 at 10:00am.
If you cancel after that, you agree to be charged a fee of $15.00 + tax per guest on the reservation. Any waiver of the fee is at the sole discretion of the restaurant.

tools.name: Venue
tools.description: Detail hop after search_venues, or when given a resy.com/cities/{city}/venues/{slug} URL. Use availability for slots.

options.name: location
options.about: City slug (`new-york-ny`) from locations or a search hit. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.

options.name: url
options.about: Pasted `https://resy.com/cities/{city}/venues/{slug}` URL (query string ignored).

options.name: url_slug
options.about: Venue slug (`sushi-ouji`); requires `location`. Pattern: ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$.

options.name: venue_id
options.about: Resy venue id (`id.resy`, e.g. 77859).

response.about: One Resy venue by id, by city slug + venue slug, or by pasted resy.com venue URL: address, coordinates, contact, cuisine, price band, rating, party size limits, currency, time zone, editorial content and collections.

fields.name: tax_included
fields.about: Whether the venue's disclosed prices include tax.

fields.name: time_zone
fields.about: Zone slot times are expressed in (site name, e.g. `EST5EDT`).

collections.name: Where to Dine with a Crew in New York

content.body: At Sushi Ouji, you’re encouraged to grab a seat at the counter and revel in an enjoyable omakase menu that showcases specially sourced ingredients - fresh fish from Tokyo and sushi-grade rice from Hokkaido - from a talented chef who’s honed his skills in Taiwan and New York.
content.name: why_we_like_it

content.body:
Welcome to SUSHI OUJI • SOHO

** Recognized by The New York Times as one of New York City’s Best 100 Restaurants (2025) ** 

We focus on high-quality seafood, primarily sourced directly from Japan, including bluefin tuna, Hokkaido uni, and kuruma ebi, selected based on seasonality and availability.
Seating is available at our 12-seat counter for a more immersive experience, as well as table seating for a relaxed pace.
-
Menu
Seasonal Omakase - $150 per guest
A 14-course progression centered on Japanese fish and seafood.
-
Dietary Restrictions
We are happy to accommodate certain dietary restrictions with advance notice, including gluten-free, dairy-free, pescatarian, and some allergies.
We are unable to accommodate vegetarian, vegan, or fully cooked menus.
Please inform us of any allergies or restrictions at the time of booking.
-
Cancellation Policy
Cancellations made within 24 hours (48 hours for larger parties) are subject to a $100 per person fee.
Reductions in party size within this window and no-shows will be charged accordingly.
-
Arrival
We allow a 15-minute grace period. We recommend arriving on time to fully enjoy the experience.

Private Events & Buyouts
For inquiries:
ouji196nyc@gmail.com
646-637-8322

content.body:
Taiwanese chef Ben brings over 18 years of experience from some of New York City’s leading sushi counters.
At Sushi Ouji, his SoHo debut, he presents a seasonal omakase in an intimate setting, guided by a simple philosophy - let the fish speak.
With a focus on sourcing, balance, and restraint, each piece is crafted to highlight the natural character of the seafood.
content.name: about
